_note: Godot-only monster options, merged over data/monsters.json (which sync_from_web.py regenerates). A key that already exists overrides just the fields given here. Move an option into web/js/monsters.js once the web version uses it, then delete it here.

staris.name: The Staris
staris.trait: A staircase that crawled off its tower. Every step is a rotated copy of the last, and it wants yours out of order.

voronoi.name: The Voronoi Golem
voronoi.trait: A body of cells grown around stolen points. Feed it the wrong points and it only gets bigger.
